Comet, Stellar Pup.original:
0: Roll a six-sided die.
1 or 2 — [+2], then create two 1/1 green Squirrel creature tokens. They gain haste until end of turn.
3 — [−1], then return a card with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to your hand.
4 or 5 — Comet deals damage equal to the number of loyalty counters on him to a creature or player, then [−2].
6 — [+1], and you may activate Comet's loyalty ability two more times this turn.

Time Vault.original:
This artifact enters tapped.
This artifact doesn't untap during your untap step.
If you would begin your turn while this artifact is tapped, you may skip that turn instead. If you do, untap this artifact.

Timetwister.original: Each player shuffles their hand and graveyard into their library, then draws seven cards. (Then put Timetwister into its owner's graveyard.)
Timetwister.texto: Cada jugador baraja su mano y su cementerio en su biblioteca, luego roba siete cartas. (Luego pon Timetwister en el cementerio de su propietario.)

Tolaria.original:
{T}: Add {U}.

Transmute Artifact.original: Sacrifice an artifact. If you do, search your library for an artifact card. If that card's mana value is less than or equal to the sacrificed artifact's mana value, put it onto the battlefield. If it's greater, you may pay {X}, where X is the difference. If you do, put it onto the battlefield. If you don't, put it into its owner's graveyard. Then shuffle.
Transmute Artifact.texto: Sacrifica un artefacto. Si lo haces, busca en tu biblioteca una carta de artefacto. Si el valor de maná de esa carta es menor o igual que el valor de maná del artefacto sacrificado, ponla en el campo de batalla. Si es mayor, puedes pagar {X}, donde X es la diferencia. Si lo haces, ponla en el campo de batalla. Si no lo haces, ponla en el cementerio de su propietario. Luego baraja.

Ultimate Alliance.original: Ultimate Alliance deals damage equal to the number of creatures you control to target creature.
Ultimate Alliance.texto: Ultimate Alliance hace a la criatura objetivo una cantidad de daño igual a la cantidad de criaturas que controlas.
